Subject: MAP: FinTechCo target close & procurement signature deadline

Jordan / Emily — great to meet earlier. Quick recap and next steps from our discovery + MAP kickoff: 

Summary of call:
- Use case: low-latency inference for fraud detection at scale (batch + streaming).
- Key non-negotiables: SOC 2 evidence, VPC/private deployment option, predictable latency SLOs for peak windows.
- Decision criteria: cost/unit, latency, security/compliance, integration effort.

Attached is a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (MAP) that maps milestones, owners, and a target close cadence. High-level asks in the MAP: 
1) Target close: May 10, 2027 (customer commit)
2) Procurement / contract signature deadline: May 12, 2027
3) Dependencies: SOC 2 report, legal redlines, procurement process window

Please review the MAP (attached) and confirm the target close/signature dates or suggest alternatives. I’ve also called out who owns each milestone — happy to update after your procurement/legal feedback.

Attachments: [Attachment: FinTechCo_MAP_Draft_v1.xlsx (xlsx)]

Proposed next steps:
- Jordan / Emily: confirm target close and procurement signature window by EOD Wed, Apr 21
- Procurement: share any required contract templates/redline process
- Redwood: provide SOC 2 evidence and a proposed SOW redline by next business day after confirmation

Thanks — I’ll update the MAP once I hear back.

Best,

Thanks Marissa — good recap. A couple of constraints from our side: 
- Decision target: leadership has committed to a May 10 internal approval (decision to move forward).
- Procurement: due to vendor review calendar and a board packet, our legal/procurement team needs until May 14 to complete contract signature (not May 12). They’ll prioritize but cannot sign before the board packet on May 13.
- Requirements: procurement has requested our standard questionnaire backfilled and SOC 2 Type II evidence. I’m looping procurement here.

Can we adjust the MAP to reflect:
- Target close (internal decision): May 10, 2027
- Procurement signature deadline: May 14, 2027

I’ve CC’d procurement (procurement@fintechco.com) and Emily (legal ops) — they’ll supply the questionnaire and any contract pointer.

Thanks — Jordan

Updated milestones (high level):
- Apr 20–23: Procurement sends questionnaire + contract template (FinTechCo) — owner: Procurement (FinTechCo)
- Apr 21–27: Redwood provides SOC 2 Type II artifacts and redline-friendly SOW — owner: Marissa / Product Security
- Apr 28–May 6: Legal review and redlines (both sides) — owner: Legal Ops (FinTechCo) + Redwood Legal
- May 10: Leadership decision / internal sign-off (FinTechCo) — owner: FinTechCo Leadership
- May 14: Contract signature (DocuSign) — owner: Procurement (FinTechCo)

- SOC 2 Type II availability (Redwood to provide)
- Timely legal redlines and confirmation of DocuSign workflow

Hi Marissa / Jordan — procurement here. Quick note on timing and required artifacts: 
- We can target DocuSign signature by May 14, 2027 (confirmed). May 12 is too early for our cycles because the board packet finalization happens May 13.
- Required: completed vendor security questionnaire, SOC 2 Type II report (or letter of attestation), and a contract template. Please provide redline-friendly SOW and indicate who on Redwood Legal will own the response.
- Contract review timeline: once we receive your redlines, our legal team estimates 3–5 business days for a first pass. If Redwood can accept our standard indemnities, this typically goes faster.
